## Task 1 · The boat and the river (3 marks)

A boat paddles with the vector (0, 8) per frame. The river pushes it with
the current (6, 0) per frame.

a) Add the two vectors. What is the real move of the boat per frame? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Find the speed of the boat: the magnitude of your answer to a). Show the
steps. (2 marks)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

## Task 2 · Can the guard see the player? (2 marks)

A guard stands at G = (3, 1) and looks up: its forward vector is
f = (0, 1). The player is at P = (1, 5).

a) Find the vector d = P − G and the dot product f · d. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Is the player in front of the guard or behind it? Give the reason. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
